tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.13.4
§ Eliashib = "God restores"
1) a priest in David's reign
2) a descendant of David
3) a high priest in Nehemiah's time
4) a temple singer with foreign wife
5) one of the line of Zattu
6) one of the line of Bani

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Eljashib, the name of six Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H410 (אֵל) and H7725 (שׁוּב); God will restore;
